title: Evidence log checkpoint
description: head-checkpoint.json and attestation-checkpoint.json in an evidence/v1 export: a signed tree head of the evidence log. Two shapes exist. A stored checkpoint carries signature and signing_key_id and its timestamp. A note checkpoint carries signed_note (a signed note, base64) and neither signature nor signing_key_id; its timestamp is optional. The schema allows both; the verifier requires the stored shape in an export. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; the signature verifies over the canonical form without the signature; origin is 1 to 256 bytes of printable UTF-8 without leading or trailing space and equals the trusted log origin; signed_note is at most 64 KiB; a signed_note excludes signature and signing_key_id; a signature needs signing_key_id; the file is at most 4 KiB (90112 bytes for a note checkpoint).

origin.description: Log origin line, such as numinance.test/log.

canon_version.description: The checkpoint-family canonical-form version; 1 in evidence/v1.

signed_note.description: A signed note as standard padded base64.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC in Go's form: Z suffix, no offset, an optional fraction of 1 to 9 digits whose last digit is not 0. Year 0000 and impossible calendar days are not excluded by the pattern.

signature.description: An Ed25519 signature: 64 raw bytes as standard padded base64, 88 characters ending ==.
